This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.2.0 update (released 17 April 2022) and two minor updates, the v1.2.0a (released 17 April 2022) and v1.2.0b (released 19 April 2022).
All towers have new faces, with some exceptions:
Damage of each bullet is no longer decreased by 50% with each pierce. It now deals full damage to first two enemies and half of the damage to the last enemy.
Pierce is no longer based on how high the damage of
is, instead all Levels have a pierce of 2.
can no longer be targeted by enemies with their attacks.
Firerate statistic display now rounds down the firerate statistic to three decimal places instead of two.
Fixed game crashing on Microsoft Store's Roblox app.
Fixed unit range not appearing correctly.
